summary: Moroni abridges the writings of Ether—Ether’s genealogy is set forth—The language of the Jaredites is not confounded at the Tower of Babel—The Lord promises to lead them to a choice land and make them a great nation.
title: The Book of Ether
meta_description: Moroni abridges the writings of Ether—Ether’s genealogy is set forth—The language of the Jaredites is not confounded at the Tower of Babel—The Lord promises to lead them to a choice land and make them a great nation.
study_intro: The record of the Jaredites, taken from the twenty-four plates found by the people of Limhi in the days of King Mosiah.

footnotes.note4_a: IE covering same period as Genesis 1–10.
